partnership_announcements.description: Cross River selected fintech platform Aion Financial Technologies as the pilot partner for its new in-house card processing engine to support Aion’s checking, payments and debit card program.

product_launches.description: Cross River Bank launched a new stablecoin payments infrastructure integrated with its real-time core system to unify fiat and on-chain stablecoin flows for fintechs, enterprises, and crypto-native firms.

press_references.value: Cross River Redefines Real-Time Card Transaction Approvals with its Advanced Authorization Offering

about_short_description.short_description: Cross River Bank is a financial institution that offers technology and banking services to consumers and businesses.

identifier.value: Cross River Operating System (COS)

product.name: Cross River Operating System (COS)
product.description: An API-driven banking core that supports account management, payments, card programs, lending workflows, and financial transaction processing.

identifier.value: Payments

product.name: Payments
product.description: API-based payment infrastructure supporting ACH, wires, real-time payments, international transfers, stablecoin transactions, and push-to-card payments.

identifier.value: Card Issuing

product.name: Card Issuing
product.description: Infrastructure for launching debit, credit, prepaid, and virtual card programs, including BIN sponsorship and support for consumer, commercial, and AI-agent transactions.

identifier.value: Card Processing

product.name: Card Processing
product.description: Card management and processing infrastructure that connects issuing programs to card networks through Cross River’s core or a customer-selected processor.

identifier.value: Accounts

product.name: Accounts
product.description: API-enabled FDIC-insured consumer and business account infrastructure for checking, savings, subledgers, deposits, and multi-rail money movement.

identifier.value: Marketplace Lending

product.name: Marketplace Lending
product.description: Bank-supervised lending infrastructure covering loan origination, underwriting, servicing, participation, reconciliation, regulatory controls, and capital-markets execution.
